test_title: RRB Technician Grade III Official Paper (Held On: 28 Dec, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Refer to the given series and answer the question that follows (all numbers are single-digit numbers only, and all counting is to be done from left to right).

(Left) 7 2 5 5 2 1 9 2 4 1 2 2 6 9 5 5 5 3 8 5 5 3 1 1 6 3 3 (Right)

How many such even digits are there, each of which is immediately preceded by a perfect square and immediately followed by an even digit? (Note: 1 will be considered as a perfect square.)
solution:
Given series: (Left) 7 2 5 5 2 1 9 2 4 1 2 2 6 9 5 5 5 3 8 5 5 3 1 1 6 3 3 (Right)

According to the question, such even digit which are immediately preceded by a perfect square and is immediately followed by an even digit:

Required condition: Perfect square - Even digit - Even digit

(Left) 7 2 5 5 2 1 __**9 2 4**__ __**1 2 2**__ 6 9 5 5 5 3 8 5 5 3 1 1 6 3 3 (Right)

Thus, there are two such even digit which are immediately preceded by a perfect square and is immediately followed by an even digit.

Hence, "Option 2" is the correct answer.
